provenance: Entirely synthetic generated test data. Broker names are illustrative labels, not real trades. Security identifiers and LEIs are synthetic, not authoritative reference data.
decimal_encoding: All precise monetary, price, rate and quantity values in this JSON are strings. Parse as System.Decimal using invariant culture. Excel stores numbers as numeric cells; apply documented quote precision and cent rounding when importing.

rules.input_boundary: Pass only the first two Excel tables to the matcher. Known_Exact_Matches exposes only 120 pairs. Keep cases, expected values and row locations in this JSON private to the test harness. Reference_data and rules may configure the engine but must not expose case mappings.
rules.identity: Collapse lifecycle first. Unique shared market reference + canonical counterparty identifies a trade, even when economic fields differ. Nonshared references are not economic differences. Without shared references use counterparty + resolved instrument + trade date + asset + normalized side + unsigned quantity. Group internal allocations or legs by Parent_Link_ID before group matching. Never match by workbook row position.
rules.side: Resolve code via broker profile. Blank Dir_Ind: negative is SELL for Bond/Equity/Forward, PAY_FIXED for Swap; positive is BUY or REC_FIXED. An explicit S/P plus negative quantity is redundant, never double-invert. Then invert side once for DEALER_BILATERAL_VIEW. Compare absolute quantities.
rules.cash_perspective: Net_Cash_Amount is signed in Reporting_Perspective. Dealer view cash must be negated to internal view. Accrued is unsigned except cancellation reversals.
rules.security_lookup: Resolve the supplied Security_ID_Source using reference_data.securities. No fuzzy ticker or description matching. All identifiers are fixture-only, including synthetic derivative identifiers.
rules.32nds: Whole-XX means whole + XX/32. A trailing + adds 1/64. For example 98-11+ = 98.359375.
rules.dirty_price: Normalized clean percent = dirty percent - accrued / unsigned face * 100. Decimal arithmetic; canonical bond clean-price precision is 6 decimals.
rules.numeric_precision: Amounts: 2 decimals, midpoint away from zero. Quantities: at most 2 decimals. Clean bond prices: 6 decimals; equity prices: 2 decimals; FX rates: 6 decimals; swap fixed rates: 6 decimals. Normalize Excel binary floating values to these scales before comparison.
rules.bond_cash: Principal_Gross = round(face * clean percent / 100, 2). BUY cash = -(principal + accrued) - fees. SELL cash = principal + accrued - fees. Coupon_Rate and Coupon are decimal fractions.
rules.equity_cash: Principal_Gross = round(shares * price, 2). BUY cash = -principal - fees. SELL cash = principal - fees.
rules.forward_cash: EUR/USD deliverable forwards: Quantity_Notional is EUR base amount, rate is USD per EUR, Currency/Trade_Ccy is EUR base currency. Principal_Gross and Net_Settlement_Amount/Net_Cash_Amount are USD quote-leg amounts. BUY base means pay USD, SELL base means receive USD. No FX conversion from Trade_Ccy should be applied to these cash fields.
rules.swap_scope: Single-currency USD SOFR fixed/float swaps. Clean_Price_Rate and Coupon are fixed-rate decimal fractions. Single-row swaps have zero modeled upfront cash. Eight two-leg examples represent a coupon-settlement snapshot, with cash due on Settle_Date; fixed accrual factor 0.25, floating rate = fixed rate + 0.0002. This reduced schema does not model reset dates, effective dates or a full cash-flow schedule.
rules.fees: Street schema has no commission column. Infer fee from normalized net cash and gross/accrued economics for Bond/Equity. A 450 fee break is a net_cash difference with root_cause COMMISSION; do not pretend a missing street fee column is directly compared.

aggregation.SUM_ALLOCATIONS: Same parent, market reference, instrument, counterparty, date, side and rate. Sum unsigned quantities, accrued and signed net cash; compare shared terms once. The three books are MACRO_RATES, STAT_ARB_EQ and CREDIT_OPP. Use sum of individually rounded allocation cash, not a newly rounded block estimate.
aggregation.SWAP_DISTINCT_NOTIONAL_SUM_CASH: Two rows are the legs of ONE swap. Verify equal notional and shared terms; retain one notional, never sum/double it. Sum signed leg cash. Side is the fixed-leg direction of the overall trade and is PAY_FIXED on both rows; Leg_Structure specifies the pay and receive leg.

rules.lifecycle: Each CANC links to the prior NEW by Cancels_Prior_Report_ID and reverses quantity, cash and accrued. Its direction is not a new trade direction. CORR points to the same prior NEW and replaces it. Exclude both NEW and CANC, retain CORR. Resolve by references, not shuffled row order. No timestamps are provided; the fixture has one unambiguous correction per chain.

tolerances.ACCRUED_USD_1_20: abs accrued delta <= 1.20 USD and cash delta must exactly reconcile to the accrued delta at the trade direction. All other economics exact.
tolerances.FX_RATE_0_0001_WITH_DERIVED_CASH: abs rate delta <= 0.0001 USD/EUR. USD cash difference must reconcile exactly to the quantity times rate delta, rounded to cents. Do not apply this as a blanket cash tolerance.
tolerances.FEE_USD_0_01: abs inferred fee delta <= 0.01 USD, with the corresponding signed cash difference. All other economics exact.

rules.tolerance_selection: Apply the asset-appropriate tolerance rules to residual differences after exact normalization. Do not select policies using hidden case labels.
rules.excluded_fields: Record IDs, execution references, internal portfolio labels, raw aliases and free-text descriptions are identity/representation metadata, not economic-diff fields. Compare the canonical fields recorded per case.
rules.dates: Excel date cells. Same day exact equality. A Nov 3 versus Nov 4 settlement on a Nov 2 trade is a deliberate T+1 versus T+2 break, not a date tolerance.
rules.blank_values: Blank product-inapplicable coupon/maturity and source-specific link fields are null, not zero. No blank quantities. No zero-quantity sign inference cases in this version.
rules.scope_limits: No options, novations, ambiguous duplicates, tax, holidays, historical market accuracy or full OTC valuation. Broker-specific formats are illustrative fixture contracts, not claims about actual broker feeds.
